schema.description: PCB SVG config contract id. pcb.svg.config.a0 remains accepted as the additive predecessor.

global.description: Global settings applied to layer outputs and composed views.

assembly.description: Assembly projection defaults for component virtual layers.

pin1.description: Pin-1 marker detection and display policy.

components.description: Per-designator overrides keyed by component designator.

layer_outputs.description: Config-driven physical layer SVG output policy.

views.description: Explicit composed SVG views. Each item has its own draw-order layer list.

pcbdoc.description: Optional PcbDoc selector when a PrjPcb contains multiple boards.

include_metadata.description: Include Altium/source metadata in SVG data attributes.

show_empty_layers.description: Emit empty physical layers when no primitives are present.

clip_to_outline.description: Clip rendered geometry to the board outline.

clip_holes_from_copper.description: Clip drills and slots out of copper layers.

mirror_bottom_view.description: Mirror bottom-side views into assembly-view orientation.

svg_scale.description: Multiplier for SVG width and height attributes.

svg_size_unit.description: Optional SVG size unit suffix, such as mm or px.

clean_output.description: Reserved cleanup flag for generated output directories.

styles.description: Default style table for physical and synthetic layers.

default_projection.description: Projection mode for fitted components. Options: bounding_box, detail, none, outline, simple.

dnp_projection.description: Projection mode for DNP components. Options: bounding_box, detail, none, outline, simple.

designator_color.description: Text color for fitted component designators.

dnp_designator_color.description: Text color for DNP component designators.

hide_silkscreen_designators.description: Hide authored physical silkscreen designators when projected assembly designators are requested. Defaults to false so --assembly preserves the board as authored.

hatch.description: Enable hatch fill for this layer/style.

line_art.description: Draw diode line art when possible.

cathode_pad_names.description: Pad names treated as cathode pads.

designator_prefixes.description: Designator prefixes treated as diode-like parts.

parameter_terms.description: Parameter text terms treated as diode-like parts.

exclude_designator_prefixes.description: Component designator prefixes excluded from automatic pin-1 markers.

enabled.description: Enable individual physical layer SVG outputs.

layers.description: Either 'auto' or a list of PCB layer names: legacy PcbLayer names, display names, or V7 semantic tokens such as 'MECHANICAL33' and 'MID31' when the installed altium-monkey exposes the V7-aware layer API.

include_special_layers.description: Synthetic layers also emitted with layer outputs. Options: BOARD_SUBSTRATE, BOARD_OUTLINE, BOARD_CUTOUTS, DRILLS, SLOTS, BEND_LINES, ASSEMBLY_HLR_TOP, ASSEMBLY_HLR_BOTTOM, ASSEMBLY_DESIGNATORS_TOP, ASSEMBLY_DESIGNATORS_BOTTOM, PIN1_TOP, PIN1_BOTTOM, SOLDERMASK_FILM_TOP, SOLDERMASK_FILM_BOTTOM, SURFACE_COPPER_TOP, SURFACE_COPPER_BOTTOM, ILLUSTRATION_TOP, and ILLUSTRATION_BOTTOM.

output_dir.description: Output directory for physical layer SVG files.

layers.description: PCB layer names for this view: legacy PcbLayer names, display names, or V7 semantic tokens such as 'MECHANICAL33' and 'MID31' when the installed altium-monkey exposes the V7-aware layer API.

bounds.description: Canvas bounds mode. Options: all_geometry, board_outline.

margin_mm.description: Canvas margin added around the chosen bounds.

assembly_designators.description: Autodoc silhouette fitting; model-less parts use electrical pads first (including flagged testpoints), with mechanical holes as a fallback.

board_substrate.description: Bare PCB fill, clipped to the outline with physical bores and scoped cutouts removed. Place BOARD_SUBSTRATE before copper and film. Applies globally or per view.

soldermask_film.description: Board-clipped inverse solder mask using saved pad/via expansions. Applies globally or per view.

bend_lines.description: Flat, region-clipped rigid-flex bend-line annotations. This does not fold or deform the board.

stroke_color.description: Text outline CSS color, drawn behind the fill.

stroke_width_mm.description: Full SVG stroke width in board millimetres. Zero disables the outline; fitting and placement are unchanged.

color.description: Global substrate CSS color override, or auto (default) for region-local authored/saved/palette resolution.

rigid_color.description: Rigid-substrate fallback CSS color used when color=auto and no authored or saved board-core color is available.

flex_color.description: Flex-substrate fallback CSS color used when color=auto and no authored material color is available.

color.description: Global film CSS color override, or auto (default) for region-local authored material, saved Altium 3D solder-mask color, and configured surface-class fallback resolution.

coverlay_color.description: Coverlay fallback CSS color used when color=auto and the authored coverlay material has no color.

line_style.description: Bend-line stroke style. Options: solid, dashed.

dash_length_mm.description: Dash and gap length in millimeters when line_style is dashed.

dash_gap_mm.description: Gap between dashes in millimeters when line_style is dashed.

extension_mm.description: Absolute distance each end extends beyond the owning-region chord, in millimeters. Zero stops at the region boundary.

fast.description: Geometer Fast candidate, tolerance and limit options. Legacy include/edge controls require an explicit poly/exact backend.

curve_mode.description: Legacy HLR curve serialization mode; Fast always emits polylines. Options: native_arcs, polyline.

samples_per_curve.description: Polyline sample count when curves are sampled.

round_digits.description: Decimal places retained in generated SVG path coordinates.

include_visible.description: Legacy poly/exact visible-edge control; leave true for Fast.

include_outline.description: Legacy poly/exact silhouette control; leave true for Fast.

union_polygons.description: Union projected polygons before converting to SVG paths.

scope.description: Cutouts used by board clipping, film and cutout artwork. Interior uses the existing Mate containment filter to exclude touching/outside contours.

hatch_color.description: Hatch color; omitted uses the cutout outline color.

hatch_opacity.description: Hatch opacity from 0.0 to 1.0, independent of the outline.

label.description: Cutout label text; an empty string disables labels.

label_color.description: Label color; omitted uses the cutout outline color.

label_max_font_size_mm.description: Maximum fitted cutout label font size in millimeters.

label_fill_ratio.description: Fraction of cutout width/height available to the fitted label (0 to 1).

label_rotation_min_gain.description: Vertical cutout text must fit this fraction larger than horizontal after the size cap.

hatch.description: Enable hatch fill for this layer/style.

outline_style.description: Outline stroke style. Options: solid, dashed.

outline_dash_mm.description: Dash length in millimeters when outline_style is dashed.

plated_color.description: SVG color for plated drill/slot features.

non_plated_color.description: SVG color for non-plated drill/slot features.

outline.description: Draw drill/slot boundaries with unfilled centers instead of filled marks.

respect_tenting.description: Hide plated drill/slot marks covered by solder mask on the rendered side.

clip_mode.description: Silkscreen clipping domain. none preserves authored overlay; board clips to board material and physical holes; film clips to the resolved solder-mask/coverlay film after apertures.

dot_diameter_mm.description: Pin-1 marker dot diameter in millimeters.

min_dot_diameter_mm.description: Minimum pin-1 marker dot diameter in millimeters.
